description: A preemptive RTOS with NEON-accelerated llama2 inference targeting the BeagleBone AI Cortex-A15.

tour.title: System Bootstrapping
tour.description: The journey begins at start.S, where the CPU is initialized, the stack is set up, and the system jumps into main.c. main.c orchestrates the rest of the kernel initialization.

tour.title: Hardware Foundation
tour.description: Explore how jcore interacts with the ARMv7-A hardware. gic.c manages the Generic Interrupt Controller, timer.c handles the system timer for preemption, and exception.c provides the entry points for hardware exceptions.

tour.title: The Minimal Runtime
tour.description: Since this is a bare-metal RTOS, it needs a minimal C runtime. minirun.c provides basic memory and runtime support, while aeabi.c implements ARM EABI helpers required by the compiler for certain operations.

tour.title: Preemptive Scheduling and Context Switching
tour.description: The heart of the RTOS. sched.c implements a round-robin scheduler. context.h defines the Process Control Block (PCB), and switch_asm.S performs the heavy lifting of saving and restoring CPU registers during a context switch.

tour.title: Synchronization and Safety
tour.description: In a preemptive environment, synchronization is key. Learn how the kernel uses spinlocks and interrupt disabling to protect shared resources.

tour.title: NEON-Accelerated Inference
tour.description: Finally, see the high-level application. llama2.c implements the core inference engine utilizing ARM NEON instructions for acceleration, and llm.c provides the high-level logic for the LLM.
